papers.title: Comparison of Single Ti6Al4V Struts Made Using Selective Laser Melting and Electron Beam Melting Subject to Part Orientation
papers.abstract: The use of additive manufacturing technologies to produce lightweight or functional structures is widespread. Especially Ti6Al4V plays an important role in this development field and parts are manufactured and analyzed with the aim to characterize the mechanical properties of open-porous structures and to generate scaffolds with properties specific to their intended application. An SLM and an EBM process were used respectively to fabricate the Ti6Al4V single struts. For mechanical characterization, uniaxial compression tests and hardness measurements were conducted. Furthermore, the struts were manufactured in different orientations for the determination of the mechanical properties. Roughness measurements and a microscopic characterization of the struts were also carried out. Some parts were characterized following heat treatment (hot isostatic pressing). A functional correlation was found between the compressive strength and the slenderness ratio (λ) as well as the equivalent diameter (d) and the height (L) of EBM and SLM parts. Hardness investigations revealed considerable differences related to the microstructure. An influence of heat treatment as well as of orientation could be determined. In this work, we demonstrate the influence of the fabrication quality of single struts, the roughness and the microstructure on mechanical properties as a function of orientation.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文章对单支柱的力学性能和表面粗糙度进行了表征，虽然不直接研究多孔结构，但为理解增材制造Ti6Al4V支柱的工艺-性能关系提供了基础数据，可用于生物医学支架设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not connect strut properties to implant stress shielding or stiffness matching, lacks fatigue testing, and does not include osseointegration or in vitro biological evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较SLM和EBM制备Ti6Al4V单支柱的力学性能与角度相关性。
summary_zh.method: 通过单向压缩和硬度测试，结合微观表征和粗糙度分析。
summary_zh.result: 发现压缩强度与长细比及等效直径的关联，热处理和取向影响硬度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩和硬度实验验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the mechanical properties of single Ti6Al4V struts fabricated by SLM and EBM under different build orientations.
summary_en.method: Uniaxial compression tests, hardness measurements, roughness and microscopic characterization were performed on struts with varying orientations and heat treatments.
summary_en.result: A functional correlation was found between compressive strength and slenderness ratio, and heat treatment and orientation significantly affect hardness.
summary_en.validation: Validation through mechanical testing (compression, hardness) and microstructural analysis.

papers.title: Cardiac transplant due to metal toxicity associated with hip arthroplasty
papers.abstract: Concerns regarding metal-on-metal (MoM) bearing couples in total hip arthroplasty are well documented in the literature with cobalt (Co) and chromium (Cr) toxicity causing a range of both local and systemic adverse reactions. We describe the case of a patient undergoing cardiac transplantation as a direct result of Co and Cr toxicity following a MoM hip replacement. Poor implant positioning led to catastrophic wear generating abundant wear particles leading to Co and Cr toxicity, metallosis, bony destruction, elevated metal ion levels, and adverse biological responses. Systemic symptoms continued for 3 years following cardiac transplantation with resolution only after revision hip arthroplasty. There was no realization in the initial cardiac assessment and subsequent transplant workup that the hip replacement was the likely cause of the cardiac failure, and the hip replacement was not recognized as the cause until years after the heart transplant. This case highlights the need for clinicians to be aware of systemic MoM complications as well as the importance of positioning when using these prostheses.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是关于金属髋关节置换术后钴铬中毒导致心脏移植的临床病例报告，不涉及任何生物力学建模或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain/SED in Gruen zones, does not report micromotion values, does not use patient-specific FE modeling, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 报道金属髋关节置换术后钴铬中毒导致心脏移植的罕见病例
summary_zh.method: 回顾性病例报告，分析临床资料与植入物定位
summary_zh.result: 患者心脏移植后仍需翻修髋关节才缓解中毒症状
summary_zh.validation: 临床病例观察，无实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To report a rare case of cardiac transplantation due to cobalt and chromium toxicity from a metal-on-metal hip replacement.
summary_en.method: A retrospective case report reviewing clinical course, implant positioning, and metal ion levels.
summary_en.result: The patient's systemic symptoms resolved only after revision hip arthroplasty, three years post-cardiac transplant.
summary_en.validation: Clinical observation without experimental or computational validation.
